intro.uz: Bu — Nodiraning dugonasi Sevaraga yozgan xati. Oʻqishdan oldin: siz dam olish kunlari nima qilasiz?

paragraphs.en: Hi Sevara, How are you? I am in a small village near Samarkand. My grandparents live here, and I visit them every month. It is very quiet here. There is a big garden with apple trees.
paragraphs.uz: Salom, Sevara! Qalaysan? Men Samarqand yaqinidagi kichik bir qishloqdaman. Bu yerda buvim va bobom yashaydi, men ularni har oy koʻrgani kelaman. Bu yer juda tinch. Bu yerda olma daraxtlari oʻsadigan katta bogʻ bor.

paragraphs.en: On Saturday, my grandfather and I go to the river. He likes fishing, but I don't. I read a book under a tree. On Sunday morning, my grandmother bakes bread in the tandir. It smells wonderful!
paragraphs.uz: Shanba kuni bobom bilan daryoga boramiz. U baliq tutishni yoqtiradi, men esa yoqtirmayman. Men daraxt tagida kitob oʻqiyman. Yakshanba kuni ertalab buvim tandirda non yopadi. Uning hidi ajoyib!

paragraphs.en: I can't use the internet here, but I don't mind. I come back to Tashkent on Monday. Can we meet on Tuesday after school? Write soon! Love, Nodira
paragraphs.uz: Bu yerda internetdan foydalana olmayman, lekin bu meni bezovta qilmaydi. Dushanba kuni Toshkentga qaytaman. Seshanba kuni darsdan keyin uchrasha olamizmi? Tezroq javob yoz! Mehr bilan, Nodira
